{{Quote|Masters. We haven’t finished liberating this world. We can hardly abandon it now.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] – to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="CC" />}}
'''Queel''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]-covered [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The planet was one of the many worlds to see action in the early [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] it was the site of a [[Battle of Queel|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the battle, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567 "Rex"]] received a new [[Mission to Mon Gazza|mission]], and General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] continued the command of the engagement.<ref name="CC" />
